online.ccextras.chat.unbanned: Your ban from the CCExtras chat has been lifted.
online.ccextras.chat.banned: You are banned from the CCExtras chat: %s
online.ccextras.chat.offline: Not connected to the CCExtras chat.
online.ccextras.chat.reported: Thanks, the message was reported to the moderators.
online.ccextras.chat.disabledHint: Online features are off. Turn them on with /ccx online an.
online.ccextras.share.gone: This shared content is no longer available.
online.ccextras.share.title: Shared content
online.ccextras.share.itemNotFound: No NECI item with that name.
online.ccextras.share.warning.item: Applying adds the item to your active favorites.
online.ccextras.share.warning.kit: Applying creates a new favorites list.
online.ccextras.share.warning.favorites: Applying creates a new favorites list.
online.ccextras.profile.clickToOpen: Click to open the profile on the website
online.ccextras.noUrl: The online features need the address of the CCExtras website (Settings → General → Online features).
online.ccextras.consent.text: CCExtras can show your profile and best values on the CCExtras website and unlock the CCExtras chat.
online.ccextras.consent.details: Sent: your name, UUID, online status and world, values from the boss bar and overlays (cactus, souls, coins, wave, kills, factory level, playtime) and messages in the CCExtras chat. You choose on the website what others can see. Turn off any time with /ccx online aus.
online.ccextras.disabled: Online features turned off. You are now offline on the website.
online.ccextras.web.link: Login link for the website (valid for 5 minutes, do not share):
settings.ccextras.online.status.desc: Connection to the CCExtras website and your rank there.
settings.ccextras.online.enabled.desc: Profile and leaderboards on the CCExtras website, CCExtras chat with direct messages, icons for other CCExtras users and sharing in chat. Only active on PlayLegend. You choose on the website what others see of your profile.
settings.ccextras.online.url.desc: For example https://ccextras.example or, for a server in your home network, http://192.168.178.20:8080.
settings.ccextras.online.icons.desc: Shows ● (user), ✦ (moderator) and ◆ (developer) before names in the tab list, chat and name tags.
settings.ccextras.online.chat.desc: Chat for all CCExtras users with direct messages. With the CCExtras chat design as tabs above the chat, otherwise with [CCX] in the normal chat (write with /ccx chat).
settings.ccextras.online.hoverProfile.de: Hovering a name in the CCExtras chat, or the icon in the server chat, shows a short profile.
settings.ccextras.online.wardrobeBags.de: When you open a wardrobe equipment set with right-click, CCExtras opens the tool and module bag automatically so tools and modules also reach your online profile. Your own click stops it.
settings.ccextras.online.web.desc: Opens a one-time login link (like /ccx web) so you can set your visibility and read direct messages on the website.
online.ccextras.season.text: Season %s was started on the CCExtras website. Do you want to do the season reset now?
online.ccextras.season.details: Resets everything CCExtras collected while playing (pinned blueprints, blueprint search, materials and essences from bags, highest wave, rune blueprints, best values). Your settings, overlays, keys and NECI favourites stay. Your profile of the old season stays visible on the website in the season archive.
online.ccextras.season.done: Season reset done: CCExtras is now in season %s.
online.ccextras.season.declined: Season reset declined. The message appears again the next time you start Minecraft.
online.ccextras.season.none: There is no season reset from the website pending.
